stagesIntro: Money for every stage of a picture, from the script to the release.

stages.name: Development
stages.text: We buy scripts and rights, and fund the work of getting a picture ready to shoot.

stages.name: Production
stages.text: We put up equity and co-finance the shoot.

stages.name: Post
stages.text: We fund the finish, through to delivery.

stages.name: Distribution
stages.text: We back the release and the sales effort.

stages.name: Lending
stages.text: We lend against a picture's rights, at any point along the way.

criteriaIntro: We invest behind evidence, not just enthusiasm. Every project gets the same six questions.

criteria.name: Marketability
criteria.text: Is there a clear audience, and a way to reach it?

criteria.name: Team
criteria.text: Have the producer and director delivered before?

criteria.name: Talent
criteria.text: Does the cast move the needle with buyers?

criteria.name: Distribution
criteria.text: Is there a credible path to sales, presales or a platform?

criteria.name: Revenue
criteria.text: Do the projections hold up when we push on them?

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.text: Where does our money sit, and what secures it?
